name: std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator<T>::allocate
intro: Allocates storage for n objects of type T using the underlying memory resource. Equivalent to return static_cast<T*>(resource()->allocate(n * sizeof(T), alignof(T)));.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
n

 -

 the number of objects to allocate storage for

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A pointer to the allocated storage.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: Throws std::bad_array_new_length if n > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / sizeof(T); may also throw any exceptions thrown by the call to resource()->allocate.
